title: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B: price, context window and specs
answer: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B is a model from PrismML, first listed on 2026-09-18. It is the only version of its line in the catalog so far. It takes text and image in and returns text, with a context window of 262K tokens and up to 32K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.08 per million input tokens and $0.5 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
